AssertionConsumerService.title: Assertion consumer service
AssertionConsumerService.description: Where the IdP sends responses. The IdP uses the first endpoint whose binding it supports, unless the request names one.

SingleLogoutService.title: Single logout service
SingleLogoutService.description: Not set: the SP takes no part in single logout.

DiscoveryResponse.title: Discovery response
DiscoveryResponse.description: Published only. Every row carries the idp-discovery-protocol binding.

certificates.description: Used to verify the SP's signatures and to encrypt assertions to it. Not set: signed requests cannot be verified and assertions are sent unencrypted.

signature_key.title: Signing key towards this SP
signature_key.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's own key.

name.title: Name
name.description: Not set: the organization display name, then the entity ID.

description.title: Description
description.description: Not read by core; shown by other modules.

OrganizationURL.title: Organization URL
OrganizationURL.description: Not read by core for this set.

attributes.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's attributes option, then every attribute.

attributesRegex.title: Attributes released, as regular expressions
attributesRegex.description: One per line. Applied only when the core:AttributeLimit filter runs.

attributes.NameFormat.title: Attribute name format
attributes.NameFormat.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then the URI format.

attributeencodings.description: Merged over the hosted IdP's encodings, attribute by attribute.

NameIDFormat.title: NameID formats
NameIDFormat.description: One per line; only the first is used. Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then transient.

nameid.encryption.title: Encrypt the NameID
nameid.encryption.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then off.

SPNameQualifier.title: SP name qualifier
SPNameQualifier.description: Used only for a transient NameID. Not set: the entity ID.

saml20.sign.response.title: Sign the response
saml20.sign.response.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then on.

saml20.sign.assertion.title: Sign the assertion
saml20.sign.assertion.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then on.

signature.algorithm.title: Signature algorithm
signature.algorithm.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then RSA-SHA256.

sign.logout.title: Sign logout messages
sign.logout.description: The hosted IdP's value wins over this one. Not set there or here: the redirect signing option.

redirect.sign.title: Sign messages sent with the redirect binding
redirect.sign.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then off.

validate.authnrequest.title: Validate the signature of authentication requests
validate.authnrequest.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then redirect validation; a signature that is present is still checked. Off: never checked, even when present.

validate.logout.title: Validate the signature of logout messages
validate.logout.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then redirect validation; a signature that is present is still checked. Off: never checked, even when present.

redirect.validate.title: Require signatures on the redirect binding
redirect.validate.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then off.

skipEndpointValidationWhenSigned.title: Accept any response location in a signed request

assertion.encryption.title: Encrypt assertions
assertion.encryption.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then off.

sharedkey.title: Shared encryption key
sharedkey.description: Not set: assertions are encrypted with the SP's certificate.

sharedkey_algorithm.title: Shared key algorithm
sharedkey_algorithm.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then AES128-GCM.

audience.title: Additional audiences
audience.description: One per line. The entity ID is always an audience.

IDPList.title: IdP list
IDPList.description: One entity ID per line. Merged with the list in the request.

assertion.lifetime.title: Assertion lifetime in seconds
assertion.lifetime.description: Not set: the hosted IdP's value, then 300.

authproc.title: Processing filters
authproc.description: Merged with authproc.idp of config.php and the hosted IdP's filters, ordered by priority.
